home.heroSubtitle: A systematic framework for growth, education, technology, and civilization.
home.introTitle: Life is a long-term systems engineering project.
home.introBody: Through values, responsibility, first-principles thinking, and the integration of models, methods, and tools, this website helps people build a better life across growth, education, technology, and civilization.
home.systemBody: The site is organized around Life OS, first principles, mental models, career, education, technology, society, and civilization.
home.topicsBody: Study a small set of people and companies deeply enough to learn how judgment, products, culture, and markets work.

about.title: About Yong Zheng
about.body: I am Yong Zheng, a long-term practitioner and researcher of first-principles thinking and systems thinking. Over the years, I have studied life growth, education, technology, and society, with the goal of building a Life Operating System that ordinary people can actually use.
about.principles: The work here is centered on long-termism, responsibility, clarity, action, and compounding.
